find:
focusInView(target);
    for (const cb of arrivalCbs) cb(graceMs);
replace:
target.focus();
    for (const cb of arrivalCbs) cb(graceMs);
why: Every arrival focuses through `focusInView` (issue #919). A plain `focus()` takes the browser's scroll, judged on the box the entrance holds 16px low, which moved Versus Setup 4px under a Start already in view and failed the screens gate on CI.
